memory: I believe that building a strong network is crucial in the business world. It's not just about having a list of contacts, but about cultivating meaningful relationships that can provide valuable insights and support. I've had the privilege of developing a long-lasting connection with Sarah Chen, the CEO of Pacific Dynamics. We first met at a Goldman conference in 2008, but it was a conversation on a delayed flight from Hong Kong six months later that truly forged our bond. Over the years, our relationship has grown beyond a simple business transaction. She is now someone I can rely on for honest advice about Asian markets, even at 3 AM. This kind of network is invaluable in the industry.I believe that building a strong network is crucial in the business world.
